game_concept: A speed quiz set in Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden, a garden of fallen statues: the spirit seeker must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of moon crystals while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden: a garden of fallen statues
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Signed values: declare resource as int, apply -resource, and print each result with %d. Dataset 2 starts with [-3, 0, 8, 11]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Duplicate Sweep' (Week 7 slot 12), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Fallen Statue Garden'.
